the amorphization and the formation of a nanocomposite structure in TiAlBSiNx coatings, after high temperature anneal, are the key factors for the improvement of the mechanical properties.

the development of high temperature stable, flexible nanocomposite TiAlBSiNO coatings for protective applications.
the development of high temperature protective coatings with a complex microstructure, which can be applied in the automotive, aerospace and energy industries.
the structural, chemical and phase transformations in the TiAlBSI N coating after high temperature treatment.

the high temperature annealing in air of the as-deposited amorphous Ti 1.5 Al 0.5 B 0.5 Si 0.5 N coating leads to the formation of a 3-D nc-TiAl3/a-SiBN(O), with the increase of the coating properties, such as hardness, reduced elastic module, H/Er and H 2/Er 3 ratio.
high temperature annealing treatment of amorphous Ti-Al-B-Si-N coatings leads to a significant improvement of tribo-mechanism properties at nano and micro-scale.

the amorphization of the TiAl 3 -SiBN(O) coating phase, after the post-deposit annealing, results in the formation of a nc-TiAl/a-SiBN(O), nanocomposite structure, which is responsible for the increase of the coating mechanical properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the high temperature annealing in ambient air, leads to the formation of a nc-TiAl/a-SiBN(O), nanocomposite structure with improved tribomechanical properties.

the high temperature treatment of amorphous Ti-Al-Si-B-N coatings leads to a phase-separation, resulting in the formation of a nanocomposite structure, which in turn leads to an improvement of the tribo-chemical and mechanical properties of the coating.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the amorphosity of the TiAlBN coating, which is the main factor for the high hardness of the as-deposited TiAlBN coatings, is not the only factor for the high temperature stability of the coating.
the TiAlBSI nanocomposite coating can be considered as a flexible coating that can be tuned for specific applications.

the TiAlBSN nanocomposite coating, after high temperature treatment in air, is able to maintain its structural and mechanical integrity and to improve its tribological properties, which makes it suitable for high temperature tribological applications.
